# Hibiscus 0.8.28

This release restores the fast, predictable note-creation flow and keeps
Hibiscus ready when you want to capture something quickly.

- Command-N and New Note now create an Untitled note immediately in the normal
  editor. You can create as many new notes as you need, with reliable focus and
  uninterrupted typing.
- The extra screen before the untitled editor has been removed.
- Command-Delete now deletes a multi-note selection through one in-place
  confirmation instead of opening each note in a separate window.
- Quick Capture keeps your text when you choose Improve or another AI action.
  Ordinary edits are no longer incorrectly labeled “Edited by AI.”
- Settings can now show or hide the Hibiscus menu-bar icon without disabling
  global shortcuts.
- Hibiscus can remain available after its windows are closed, keeping Quick
  Capture and global shortcuts ready. Choosing Quit still exits the app.
- Compact on-device Apple dictation now stays in its focused recording flow,
  including while microphone and speech permissions are being granted.
- The Founder offer is now the first and default perpetual-license option.
  Checkout uses fixed USD pricing, supports promotion codes, and works from the
  Hibiscus website.
- License delivery is now durable and retryable. Approved no-cost family
  promotions are handled safely, while unrelated Stripe checkout events are
  ignored.
